entries.title: Numbers 33:1
segments: These [are] the journeys of the sons of Israel, who went forth out of the land of Egypt with their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

entries.title: Numbers 33:2
segments: And Moses wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the command of the LORD. And these [are] their journeys according to their starting-places.

entries.title: Numbers 33:3
segments: And they pulled up from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the next day after the Passover the sons of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians.

entries.title: Numbers 33:4
segments: For the Egyptians buried all [their] first-born whom the LORD had stricken among them. The LORD also executed judgments upon their gods.

entries.title: Numbers 33:5
segments: And the sons of Israel pulled up from Rameses and pitched in Succoth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:6
segments: And they pulled up from Succoth and pitched in Etham, in the edge of the wilderness.

entries.title: Numbers 33:7
segments: And they pulled up from Etham and turned again to Pihahiroth which [is] in front of Baal-zephon. And they pitched in front of Migdol.

entries.title: Numbers 33:8
segments: And they pulled up from before Pihahiroth and passed through the middle of the Sea into the wilderness, and went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and pitched in Marah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:9
segments: And they pulled up from Marah and came to Elim. And in Elim [were] twelve fountains of water, and seventy palm trees. And they pitched there.

entries.title: Numbers 33:10
segments: And they pulled up from Elim and pitched by the Red Sea.

entries.title: Numbers 33:11
segments: And they pulled up from the Red Sea and pitched in the wilderness of Sin.

entries.title: Numbers 33:12
segments: And they pulled up from of the wilderness of Sin and pitched in Dophkah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:13
segments: And they pulled up from Dophkah and pitched in Alush.

entries.title: Numbers 33:14
segments: And they pulled up from Alush and pitched at Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

entries.title: Numbers 33:15
segments: And they pulled up from Rephidim and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.

entries.title: Numbers 33:16
segments: And they pulled up from the wilderness of Sinai and pitched at Kibroth-hattaavah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:17
segments: And they pulled up from Kibroth-hattaavah and pitched at Hazeroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:18
segments: And they pulled up from Hazeroth and pitched in Rithmah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:19
segments: And they pulled up from Rithmah and pitched at Rimmon-parez.

entries.title: Numbers 33:20
segments: And they pulled up from Rimmon-parez and pitched in Libnah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:21
segments: And they pulled up from Libnah and pitched at Rissah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:22
segments: And they pulled up [stakes] from Rissah and pitched in the Meeting Place.

entries.title: Numbers 33:23
segments: And they pulled up from Kehelathah and pitched in Mount Shapher.

entries.title: Numbers 33:24
segments: And they pulled up from Mount Shapher and pitched in Haradah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:25
segments: And they pulled up from Haradah and pitched in Makheloth

entries.title: Numbers 33:26
segments: And they pulled up from Makheloth and pitched at Tahath.

entries.title: Numbers 33:27
segments: And they pulled up from Tahath and pitched at Tarah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:28
segments: And they pulled up from Tarah and pitched in Mithcah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:29
segments: And they pulled up from Mithcah and pitched in Hashmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:30
segments: And they pulled up from Hashmonah and pitched at Moseroth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:31
segments: And they pulled up from Moseroth and pitched in Bene-jaakan.

entries.title: Numbers 33:32
segments: And they pulled up from Bene-jaakan and pitched at the Hole of the Cleft.

entries.title: Numbers 33:33
segments: And they pulled up from the Hole of the Cleft and pitched in Jotbathah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:34
segments: And they pulled up from Jotbathah and pitched at Ebronah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:35
segments: And they pulled up from Ebronah and pitched at Ezion-geber.

entries.title: Numbers 33:36
segments: And they pulled up from Ezion-geber and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which [is] Kadesh.

entries.title: Numbers 33:37
segments: And they pulled up from Kadesh and pitched in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

entries.title: Numbers 33:38
segments: And Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel had come up out of the land of Egypt, in the first of the fifth month.

entries.title: Numbers 33:39
segments: And Aaron [was] a hundred and twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

entries.title: Numbers 33:40
segments: And king Arad the Canaanite, who lived in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 33:41
segments: And they pulled up from Mount Hor and pitched in Zalmonah.

entries.title: Numbers 33:42
segments: And they pulled up from Zalmonah and pitched in Punon.

entries.title: Numbers 33:43
segments: And they pulled up from Punon and pitched in Oboth.

entries.title: Numbers 33:44
segments: And they pulled up from Oboth and pitched in Ije-abarim, in the border of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:45
segments: And they pulled up from Iim and pitched in Dibon-gad.

entries.title: Numbers 33:46
segments: And they pulled up from Dibon-gad and pitched in Almon-diblathaim.

entries.title: Numbers 33:47
segments: And they pulled up from Almon-diblathaim and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

entries.title: Numbers 33:48
segments: And they pulled up from the mountains of Abarim and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan [at] Jericho.

entries.title: Numbers 33:49
segments: And they pitched by Jordan, from The House of Deserts to The Meadow of Acacias in the plains of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 33:50
segments: And the LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab beside Jordan, [at] Jericho, saying,

entries.title: Numbers 33:51
segments: Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, When you have passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan,

entries.title: Numbers 33:52
segments: then you shall drive out all those who live in the land from before you, and destroy all their carved images, and destroy all their molded images and pluck down all their high places.

entries.title: Numbers 33:53
segments: And you shall possess the land, and live in it. For I have given you the land to possess it.

entries.title: Numbers 33:54
segments: And you shall divide the land by lot by your families. And you shall give the more inheritance to the many; to the few you shall give the less inheritance. Wherever the lot falls out to him; according to the tribes of your fathers you shall inherit.

entries.title: Numbers 33:55
segments: But if you will not drive out the people of the land from before you, then it will be, those of them whom you let remain [shall] be goads in your eyes and thorns in your sides, and they shall trouble you in the land in which you live.

entries.title: Numbers 33:56
segments: And it shall be, as I thought to do to them, so I shall do to you.
